title: The Paired River Hammer Discourse
summary: A discourse on joining two flows of force like paired rivers so the hammer falls with both at once.

summary: A codex of twelve methods that run body and qi on two tracks and join them in the crushing grip of the hammer.

title: Azure Basin Canon of the Unbroken Line

summary: Ten rules by which the wind-sworn hammerman lets a heavy swing ride the wind and still land on the bearing taken.

title: A Bearing for the Breaking Hammer
summary: Eleven methods built on taking one bearing on the foe and breaking everything that stands along it.

title: Gale Words on the Open Edge
summary: Gale words for fighting at the open edge of the plateau where nothing stands between the hammer and the wind.

title: The Squall Hammer Discourse
summary: A discourse on twelve methods in which the hammer arrives with the sudden force of a squall off the plateau.

title: Plateau Rider's Book of the Hammer
summary: A book for riders of the open plateau who fight with the heavy hammer from the saddle and on the ground.

title: Updraft and Downfall: A Wind-Sworn Canon
summary: A wind-sworn canon that pairs the lift of the updraft with the weight of the downfall in each hammer blow.

title: The Long Oath of the Gale Hammer
